## 🧪 Guarantees map

> [!NOTE]
> Every public guarantee of `rspack-plugin-svg-sprite`, and the tests that enforce it. A guarantee with no test is marked `⚠️ not enforced`.

|                      |                                                                                          |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **What this is**     | The contract of the package, derived from the README, the changelog and the test suite   |
| **Kept honest by**   | `src/__tests__/guarantees.test.ts` fails when a file or test name below no longer exists |
| **Reference format** | `` `file` › "text from the test title" ``                                                |
